questions.question: Which annotation switches JPA auditing on for the application?
questions.explanation: @EnableJpaAuditing on a configuration class turns the feature on. Without it the audit fields stay null.

questions.question: What is the job of a bean that implements AuditorAware?
options: It formats dates for the browser
It tells Spring who the current user is for @CreatedBy and @LastModifiedBy
questions.explanation: AuditorAware returns the current auditor, usually the logged-in user name.

questions.question: A ticket is saved at 10:00 and its status is changed and saved again at 10:05. Which pair describes createdAt and updatedAt after the second save?
questions.explanation: @CreatedDate is written once on insert, while @LastModifiedDate moves on every update.

questions.question: An entity has @CreatedDate and @LastModifiedDate fields and @EnableJpaAuditing is present, but both fields are always null. What is the most likely cause?
options: The fields are of type Instant
The table uses an IDENTITY key
questions.explanation: The listener is what fills the fields, so an entity without it is never audited.

questions.question: After a JPQL bulk update statement, the updatedAt column of the changed rows has not moved. Why?
options: Bulk JPQL updates skip entity listeners
questions.explanation: A bulk update statement goes straight to the database without loading entities, so the auditing listener never runs.
